title: ghs_-prefixed JWT with no app identifier segment
summary: A synthetic ghs_ value that goes straight from the prefix to a three-segment JWT, with no app identifier segment.
rationale: The recommended expression allows this shape, but the provider writes the stateless form as ghs_APPID_JWT and does not say whether the segment is always present. Whether such a value is an installation token is a grammar question the sources do not settle.

expectation.rationale: No expectation is asserted. The recommended expression matches the value, while the notation implies an app id segment; neither source says whether it is optional. A reading proposing a flag is recorded on the fixture as non-asserting data. Resolving it needs a provider statement on the APPID segment.

sources.supports: ghs_APPID_JWT notation; about 520 characters; applications relying on exactly 40 characters may break.
Stateless token is a ghs_-prefixed JWT with two dots; recommended expression ghs_[A-Za-z0-9\.\-_]{36,}.
sources.locator: How to use it; Verifying the token type

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

relations.note: The app id segment and its underscore removed from the stateless literal.
